ambient: The carrier holds. Nothing modulates it.
A gap of perhaps a second, in which something almost says a word.
The tone gets a fraction closer to a voice, and corrects itself.
description: There is nothing here and it is arriving steadily. Not darkness, but an even, unbroken tone of absolutely no information, filling everything at a comfortable volume. You have the strong impression that this is being transmitted deliberately, and well, by someone conscientious.
name: Carrier Wave

looks: There is something under it, at the very bottom, keeping time.
It stops. The stopping is much louder.
objects.name: the tone

looks: All of them, evenly, which is how you know it is being done properly.
It has a source. The source is patient and has been at this a long time.
objects.name: the direction it comes from

weather: No weather. An even, unbroken absence of it, arriving steadily and at a comfortable volume.
